summary: Folded into umbrella MPI-528 by the consolidation sweep.
Re-opened the 2026-08-03 keep decision at user request: seek replacement Illustrious / Pony checkpoints with a clean Image commercial-use grant.

Closed won't-fix. Vision is a free open-source app; commercial output rights were never guaranteed and the H3 consent box already puts that on the user. DMD2 (cc-by-nc-4.0, hash-proven, merged at 0.7 into all five SDXL weights) made the card's goal unreachable regardless. No code changed, no merge run.
